Scholarship overview

The Swiss Government Excellence doctoral scholarship supports research with an approved Swiss academic host. Applicants need to arrange supervision and use the rules for their country of origin. The maintenance award should not be confused with an automatic waiver of every host-university fee.

Research Areas

  • Eligible doctoral research subjects
  • International research
  • Doctoral study

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryCHF 2,450/month
TuitionFee waiver depends on the host; not automatic under the scholarship

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityCountry-specific eligibility
Further conditionsHost professor support required; tuition is not universally waived; check country rules.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusCountry-dependent call
Deadline / consideration roundCountry-of-origin-specific deadline
LocationSwitzerland
Details checked9 October 2026

About Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI)

SERI publishes the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship information and country application guidance. Doctoral applicants arrange a Swiss academic host and follow the scholarship process for their country of origin.
